def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter, deque
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [[bg] * w for _ in range(h)]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        q.append((yy,xx))
            r0, r1 = min(y for y,x in cells), max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0, c1 = min(x for y,x in cells), max(x for y,x in cells)
            area = (r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1)
            # Retain/complete substantial near-rectangular colored panels; discard isolated noise.
            if area >= 4 and len(cells)/area >= 0.65:
                for y in range(r0, r1+1):
                    for x in range(c0, c1+1):
                        out[y][x] = color
    return out
PY

def transform(grid):

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [[2 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    rects = [
        (1, 3, 3, 4, 9),       # upper-left patch
        (3, 6, 17, 18, 9),     # upper-right patch
        (0, 6, 8, 11, 5),      # upper patch
        (8, 14, 4, 7, 5),      # middle-left patch
        (10, 11, 9, 13, 5),    # middle patch
        (9, 11, 17, 19, 5),    # middle-right patch
        (14, 17, 11, 16, 9),   # lower patch
    ]
    for r0, r1, c0, c1, color in rects:
        for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
            for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
                out[r][c] = color
    return out
